snippet.title: Mug Shot! – a cozy coffee-shop deckbuilder for iPhone
snippet.description:
Every shift is a card puzzle: pull shots, steam milk, pour art and serve the queue. Stack the right cards and watch the combos snowball.
Free to try, then one purchase unlocks the whole tour. No ads, no account, plays offline.
Out now on iPhone, coming to Android. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6817104154
#cozygames #deckbuilder #roguelite #iosgaming #indiegames
